title: 14th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/1/2025).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99), submitted on behalf of the government by Thimarafushi MP Ahmed Riyaz.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Republic of the Philippines.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations of non-resident ambassadors to the Kingdom of Spain and New Zealand.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting continued debate on the Tourism Act amendment bill and took up committee reports on non-resident ambassador nominees for the Philippines, Spain and New Zealand.
